parameters.jsCode: const docs=$input.all().map(x=>x.json.document||x.json).filter(x=>typeof x.pageContent==='string' && x.metadata?.sourceId==='1ZDkbcuwpWG1MEKsD3zc775_hU8-bUad0').map((d,i)=>({id:i+1,text:d.pageContent,metadata:d.metadata||{}}));const fallback="I couldn't find this information in the BrightPath Employee Handbook. The fallback must have an empty sourceIds array. Fallback: '+fallback+'\nExcerpts: '+JSON.stringify(docs)+'\nQuestion: '+JSON.stringify($('Validate question').first().json.question)}}];

const docs=$('Build grounded question').first().json.docs;const fallback="I couldn't find this information in the BrightPath Employee Handbook. return [{json:{status:503,body:{ok:false,error:'service_unavailable',message:'The request could not be completed. Contact HR with this reference.',reference:$execution.id}}}];
